output.title: Why Building One Real End-to-End Project Beats Five Tutorial Clones
output.rationale: Recruiters see hundreds of identical weather apps and to-do lists on fresher resumes. Demonstrating one deployed, well-documented project shows engineering judgment and ownership.
output.hook: Stop adding tutorial clones to your GitHub. One messy, real-world project you actually debugged will outscore ten polished copy-paste repos in an internship interview.
